name: Voice of Monsters
body:
Drawbacks
Voice of Monsters
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Lamashtu
Your faith leads you to see the power and wonder in even the most horrible abominations. Once per day, you can cast speak with animals. When you cast this spell, it can affect animals (as normal) as well as aberrations and magical beasts with an Intelligence of 2 or lower.
